series_break: ARCH-3 -> ARCH-4 is explicit because A/B diagnostics and B proof consume ESI-3 ownership/reference evidence.

authority.statement: ARCH-4 is advisory architecture evidence inside normal EtuSchlopf gates; it never authorizes deletion or mutation by itself.

A.label: Loeschbar
A.meaning: Same strict closed-unreachable private free-function proof, now with ESI-3 include/macro/self/reference ownership. Candidate component and exact blockers are exported.

B.label: Zusammenfuehrbar / redundant
B.meaning: Exact duplicate signature-shape+body evidence creates a B candidate only. B classification requires an explicit legacy/obsolete/deprecated/shadow name, exactly one productively reachable non-test/tool exact counterpart, and no fail-independent governance/audit boundary blocker.

C.label: Notwendige Unterstuetzung
C.meaning: Productively reachable support or explicitly bound test/tool support without D authority.

D.label: Autoritativer Kern
D.meaning: Same symbol-level ARCH-3 authority rules; path/module names alone do not establish D.

OFFEN.label: Nicht sicher entscheidbar
OFFEN.meaning: Mandatory fail-closed default when A/B/C/D proof is incomplete.

comparability.rule: A/B/C/D/OFFEN counts are directly comparable only within identical ARCH contract versions.

deletion_boundary: Class A is static evidence only; actual deletion remains subject to normal Take Change Control, build, Clippy, tests, Kodex and runtime gates.
